description: Liège Métropole - hubs de mobilité et réseau P+R is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Liège Métropole. Coordonnées cartographiques des hubs de mobilité sur le territoire de l'Arrondissement de Liège. Ces hubs constituent les pôles d’échanges multimodaux qui concentrent services de mobilité (transport en commun, mobilité partagée) et infrastructures de parking (voiture que vélo). The 2 datasets in this record: Hubs mobilité - Arrondissement de Liège; Réseau P+R - Arrondissement de Liège. Coverage: Liège arrondissement (Wallonia). The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are MOBILITY IN LIEGE METROPOLE. The portal shows 39 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2025-07-10 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
